products.variantName: Personalised Memento Company Clear Christmas House Glass Bauble - One Size
products.sourceDescription:
Add a special touch to your Christmas tree with this Personalised Christmas House Glass Bauble, a beautifully elegant decoration designed to bring warmth and sentiment to your festive celebrations. Featuring a charming house design, this glass bauble is perfect for creating meaningful Christmas memories and makes a thoughtful personalised Christmas gift for family, friends or loved ones.




This personalised Christmas decoration can be personalised with a year and two lines of 20 characters.




Ideal for hanging on your Christmas tree, displaying around the home or gifting during the festive season, it adds a stylish and sentimental finishing touch to any Christmas décor.




Please ensure all personalisation details are entered carefully, as the text will appear exactly as provided. Crafted from glass and supplied with a ribbon ready to hang, this timeless bauble is a keepsake to treasure year after year.




-When you have placed your order, you will receive an email from matalan@personalisedmemento.co.uk. Follow the link to submit the personalised details you require.


-If we don't receive your personalisation within 24 hours the order will be cancelled. Please check your junk folder for the email.


-Once personalisation has been submitted the order cannot be cancelled or amended as it will automatically be sent into production and will be despatched within 3 working days.

Whether you're celebrating who you are or standing proudly as an ally, these inclusive matching sets were made with one belief in mind: love is love - and everyone deserves to feel seen, celebrated, and cosy!




GRS Certified


These pyjamas are made from recyclable fabrics! That means we’ve taken materials that would’ve ended up as waste and turned them into something cosy, comfy, and full of Christmas cheer. So while you’re making memories in your matching jammies, you’re also doing your bit for the planet.

products.sourceDescription:
Our Personalised Reindeer Christmas Luxury Sack is a great way to present their Christmas treats from Santa.




The sack can be personalised with a name up to 12 characters in length, to appear as entered.




This sack is made from fleece and comes supplied with a 7cm mock cord. the opening is elasticated.




This item is not a toy, not suitable for under 36 months. Always use under adult supervision.




Sponge clean only.




Material is 100% Polyester. Please keep away from fire.




Ideal for Christmas




-When you have placed your order, you will receive an email from matalan@personalisedmemento.co.uk. Follow the link to submit the personalised details you require.


-If we don't receive your personalisation within 24 hours the order will be cancelled. Please check your junk folder for the email.


-Once personalisation has been submitted the order cannot be cancelled or amended as it will automatically be sent into production and will be despatched within 3 working days.
